_comment: Copy to config/gate-policy.local.json (gitignored, protected by the gate). Personal / site-specific additions on top of .codebuddy/rules/gate-policy.json. Allowed keys: mode, l2_default, approval_ttl_sec, rules, rule_overrides. Placeholders work here too.

rules.note: name the write tools of your own MCP servers so the gate reports a specific rule

l3-mcp-write-default.note: only gate these servers by default; others fall to L2
